thread:
Nadia: Postmortem for Cust-Meridian Dedicated cluster posted. Root causes: flapping VPC peering + on-prem NAT conntrack exhaustion + kube-proxy IPVS sticky session bug causing pod isolation. Pulling together owners and actions below.

Ethan: Oof. Owners/ETAs? Also did we confirm asymmetric routing made this worse?

Priya: Yes, asymmetric return path on customer gateway caused SYNs to land on different NAT session table entries; conntrack blew past threshold. Kernel log snippet: `nf_conntrack: table full, dropping packet`. We also hit a kube-proxy IPVS bug where endpoint removals left stale entries.

Jules: Proposed owners:
- Ethan: peering stability + routing fallback policy (ETA 48h)
- Priya: on‑prem reproducibility, conntrack sizing guidance, and runbook edits (ETA 5d)
- Nadia: CS comms + SLA impact (ETA 3h)
- Jules: kube-proxy/IPVS remediation and node-level hardening (ETA 7d)

Nadia: Short-term mitigations (apply now): enable regional fallback for Meridian, set tcp_keepalive_time=15, bump nf_conntrack_max to 262144 on affected gateways (config via template), and send initial customer note. ETA for the bundle: 3h.

Priya: Mid/long actions:
- publish "Meridian NAT sizing" calc with examples for 1M short connections/hour (ETA 6d)
- add conntrack>70% alert & runbook automation to scale NAT pool or auto-fallback (ETA 8d)
- document asymmetric routing checks for CS onboarding checklist (ETA 5d)

Jules: Kube/IPVS actions: backport fix for stale endpoint removal, add kube-proxy health check to evict stuck mappings, and schedule node-level stress test with churned endpoints (ETA 14d). Repro snippet for runbook: ```
# light repro for conntrack + asymmetric return
for i in $(seq 1 400); do timeout 1 bash -c "</dev/tcp/${PEER_IP}/$((1024 + i % 2000))" & done; sleep 2; dmesg | tail -n 20 | grep conntrack
```

TicketBot: Created tickets INC-72011, REM-72012, CS-72013. Links: https://jira.redwood/INC-72011

Ethan: Cross-customer task: correlate peering BGP flaps, asymmetric-route reports, and kube-proxy restarts across Dedicated customers for last 180 days. Owner: Ethan. ETA 2026-01-20. Propose a biweekly "peering+edge" retro in incident rotation.

Nadia: Good. Please attach lab captures (tcpdump, conntrack dumps, kube-proxy logs) to REM-72012. If blocked, escalate to #eng-oncall. Closing thread after tickets are updated.

Priya: Ack. Adding runbook note: `sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=262144` and `sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_tcp_timeout_established=86400` with guidance.

Jules: I'll open a PR for kube-proxy fix and tests today.

Nadia: Thanks team. We'll review progress in the first "peering+edge" retro next week.
